title: China Shock 2.0: Rethinking Its Role in Dry Bulk
section_path: China Shock 2.0: Rethinking Its Role in Dry Bulk
section_path_text: China Shock 2.0: Rethinking Its Role in Dry Bulk
summary:
Main
Image reference: assets/2026-11-02_china-shock-20-rethinking-its-role-in-dry-bulk_img_rgb-color-brs-shipbrokers-monogram-l_c365f35f1de5.png
China's role in dry bulk shipping needs reassessing. Property development, infrastructure and rising consumption once provided a broad foundation for raw-material imports. Today, the debate over "China Shock 2.0" reflects two interpretations: an external view emphasising excess production and weak domestic demand, and Beijing's view emphasising competitiveness and industrial upgrading.
